dailyArchitecture: RuneLite plugin -> PluginSnapshotEndpoint/WorldModelCache -> live_core_daemon.py -> in-memory context -> Knowledge Fabric/debug bundles -> optional brain intent overlay_debug_state.json

categories.daily: Shown in the main Live Control Panel daily view.
categories.advanced_debug: Diagnostics and inspection tools; useful, but not required for daily live.
categories.legacy_file_pipeline: Old rolling-file live stack. Live packet archive input is retired; use only explicit bounded debug files.
categories.batch_audit: Offline/debug recording, geometry, dataset, and audit tools.
categories.experimental: Explicit diagnostics hidden from daily mode. Compact stream/live packet archives are retired.
categories.deprecated: Compatibility or uncertain tools; do not show in daily UI.

tools.name: live_control_panel.py
tools.purpose: Simple daily launcher, Mission Control status view, and runtime-control surface for the daily daemon.
tools.input: latest session and local helper process state
tools.output: daily/advanced launcher UI and bounded process logs

tools.name: live_core_daemon.py
tools.purpose: Daily in-memory live daemon. Snapshot no-file mode uses PluginSnapshotEndpoint/WorldModelCache. Context/brain endpoints are in memory, live packet archives are retired, overlay state is optional, and startup --preset is a mission-preset alias.
tools.normalCommand: python telemetry-viewer\live_core_daemon.py --latest-session --profile woodcutting --daily-mode snapshot-no-files --input-source plugin-snapshot --plugin-snapshot-tier hot --preset woodcut_bank --goal-count 5 --context-port 8890 --write-overlay-state --overlay-mode intent --overlay-backup-candidates 2 --overlay-debug-target-limit 10 --human-dashboard --summary --benchmark
tools.input: PluginSnapshotEndpoint and WorldModelCache; live packet archives are retired
tools.output: localhost context/brain/status endpoints and optional capped brain intent overlay_debug_state.json

tools.name: control_live_daemon.py
tools.purpose: Local read-only runtime control CLI for live_core_daemon mission presets, task policy, goal count, observe-only mode, and baseline reset.
tools.output: stdout status or JSON; no file writes

tools.name: mission_snapshot.py
tools.purpose: One-shot Mission Snapshot diagnostic for bug reports and before/after comparisons. Reads daemon /health, /status, and /control once; stdout by default; optional single JSON file only with --output.
tools.output: concise human summary or one JSON object; no continuous logging or NDJSON; optional single explicit JSON file with --output

tools.name: live_config_doctor.py
tools.purpose: Preset-aware daily PASS/WARN/FAIL configuration doctor.
tools.input: session files, optional daemon/context/plugin health endpoints, optional process list

tools.name: run_daily_gauntlet.py
tools.purpose: Daily daemon sanity check for context health, progress invariants, duplicate processes, and required context domains.
tools.input: live_core_daemon endpoints, latest session, optional process list

tools.name: run_woodcut_bank_live_qa.py
tools.purpose: One-command woodcut_bank live QA runner for plugin snapshot login, daemon health, full-cycle context, history, resource-return state, overlay selection, and gauntlet-style semantic deferrals.
tools.input: plugin snapshot endpoint and live_core_daemon localhost endpoints
tools.output: woodcut_bank_live_qa.v1 PASS/WARN/FAIL report; no file writes

tools.name: resource_progress.py
tools.purpose: Single source of truth for daily woodcutting held-vs-baseline progress.
tools.input: inventory snapshots and woodcutting resource definitions
tools.output: ResourceProgressResult with valid matched slots and progress fields

tools.name: runtime_control.py
tools.purpose: In-memory validation and state model for safe live_core_daemon runtime control updates.
tools.output: RuntimeControlResult with accepted/rejected fields and noActionEmitted=true

tools.name: mission_presets.py
tools.purpose: Static named mission presets for in-memory sidecar brain/context runtime control; no game actions.
tools.normalCommand: imported by runtime_control.py, control_live_daemon.py, and live_control_panel.py
tools.input: preset name such as woodcut_bank, woodcut_firemake, woodcut_drop, observe_only, or combat_default

tools.name: brain_core.py
tools.purpose: Read-only brain interpretation layer used by the daemon; no action output.
tools.output: brain_decision.v1 / human brain summary with no actions

tools.name: capabilities.py
tools.purpose: Capability status and alias normalization for analyzer contracts and concise daily output.
tools.normalCommand: imported by analyzers, brain_core.py, and live_context_format.py
tools.input: static capability names and legacy aliases
tools.output: normalized capability IDs and capability status records

tools.name: analyzers\*.py
tools.purpose: Pure in-memory analyzers used inside live_core_daemon.py for inventory, targets, navigation intent, read-only pathing context, service/process context, bank UI context, activity, brain context, and intent overlay markers.
tools.output: LiveAnalysisResult context objects; no files or services

tools.name: live_context_format.py
tools.purpose: Human formatting for context and brain output.
tools.normalCommand: imported by live_core_daemon.py and query tools

tools.name: navigation_reachability.py
tools.purpose: Read-only local reachability helpers for candidate context.

tools.name: maintenance.py
tools.purpose: Reports and prunes retired legacy live_packets/live-*.ndjson files only when explicitly requested.
tools.output: legacy cleanup report or dry-run/apply prune report

tools.name: telemetry_paths.py
tools.purpose: Session/file discovery helpers.
tools.output: resolved latest sessions and telemetry paths

tools.name: task_resources.json
tools.purpose: Resource ID definitions for daily progress; woodcutting logs only in daily use.

tools.name: task_script_api.py
tools.purpose: High-level task script primitive contract, validation, compile, evidence planning, runtime evidence snapshots/comparison, failure classification, explanation, templates, and scene-probe helpers over the existing engine.
tools.normalCommand: MCP tools: get_task_script_api_spec, validate_task_script, compile_task_script, get_task_script_evidence_plan, get_task_script_runtime_evidence, compare_task_script_runtime_evidence, classify_task_failure, explain_script_plan, suggest_task_template, probe_task_from_scene
tools.input: task_script.v1 JSON, static task policies, loaded-scene Knowledge Fabric data for probes
tools.output: task_script_api_spec.v1, task_script_validation.v1, task_script_plan.v1, task_script_evidence_plan.v1, task_runtime_evidence.v1, task_runtime_evidence_comparison.v1, task_failure_classification.v1, task_script_explanation.v1, task_scene_probe.v1

tools.name: capability_registry.json
tools.purpose: Read-only capability metadata exposed by context APIs.

tools.name: watch_library.json
tools.purpose: Read-only watch definitions for diagnostics; not action planning.

tools.name: check_live_setup.py
tools.purpose: Plugin snapshot/world model setup check plus legacy live packet disk warning.

tools.name: inspect_live_packets.py
tools.purpose: Retired compatibility shim that points to current context/debug/maintenance commands.

tools.name: diagnose_brain_progress.py
tools.purpose: Diagnoses daily resource progress from daemon memory or explicit debug files.
tools.input: daemon brain status or debug live files
tools.output: brain progress diagnostic with invariant warnings

tools.name: diagnose_inventory_slots.py
tools.purpose: Inspects inventory slot snapshots and resource matching.

tools.name: diagnose_overlay_state.py
tools.purpose: Compares overlay state against live candidates/context.

tools.name: diagnose_overlay_geometry.py
tools.purpose: Inspects overlay geometry details for visual QA.

tools.name: diagnose_pathing_context.py
tools.purpose: One-shot read-only diagnostic for daemon Pathing Context v1. Reads /status only and prints to stdout; JSON mode is stdout-only.
tools.output: destination tile, final approach tile, next waypoint, predicted path preview, local reachability, and missing capabilities; no file writes

tools.name: diagnose_service_context.py
tools.purpose: One-shot read-only diagnostic for policy-gated service candidate visibility. Reads /status only and prints to stdout; JSON mode is stdout-only.
tools.output: profile/service candidate counts, service candidate inputs, candidate types, top service-like raw candidates, and tier/cap visibility notes; no file writes

tools.name: diagnose_bank_ui_context.py
tools.purpose: One-shot read-only diagnostic for daemon Bank UI / Service State Context v1. Reads /status only and prints to stdout; JSON mode is stdout-only.
tools.output: bank open/readable/pin state, widget visibility, inventory summary, bank summary, warnings, and missing capabilities; no file writes

tools.name: diagnose_resource_return_context.py
tools.purpose: One-shot read-only diagnostic for remembered resource return destination state after banking. Reads /status only and prints to stdout; JSON mode is stdout-only.
tools.output: resource memory validity, return destination tile/source, target visibility, phase/intent, warnings, and missing capabilities; no file writes

tools.name: diagnose_woodcut_bank_scenarios.py
tools.purpose: Synthetic in-memory woodcut_bank state-machine scenario suite covering collection, service, bank, return, retained booth fallback blocking, and remembered return destination states. Prints to stdout only.
tools.input: built-in synthetic daemon-shaped contexts and existing analyzer/classifier helpers
tools.output: woodcut_bank_scenario_suite.v1 PASS/WARN/FAIL report; no file writes
